name: EPIC 211477011
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 16, 10.1 solar radii and 0.90 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 211477011 (K2 campaign 16): PARAM radius (solar radii) 10.077623 (16th-84th percentiles 9.837712-10.317506), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 211477011: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 4808.0186 +/- 62 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 211477011 (K2 campaign 16): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 2719.0625 (16th-84th percentiles 2667.929688-2771.09375), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

color.reason: PARAM fits an extinction A_V = 0.07 mag toward this star (Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, AV-M), and the color routes do not remove extinction; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant 2,719 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 16, give 0.90 solar masses and 10.1 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,808 K at its surface.
